claims.claim_text: The indexed Berkley C. Ball is very likely Berkley Clark Ball of Arlington, Virginia, who entered the U.S. Army in 1944.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Two contemporary newspaper items give the uncommon exact name, expand the middle initial, locate him in Arlington, and document Army entry and private rank.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the rare exact name, middle-name expansion, Arlington location, Fort Meade induction chronology, and compatible Army progression from private to the indexed private first class.
claims.temporal_assessment: The newspapers establish Army status in April and May 1944. They do not state when he entered OSS or whether the Army was his immediate pre-OSS assignment.
claims.match_notes: Not marked confirmed because neither newspaper prints the private identifier or links the subject directly to Box 32 or OSS. No civilian occupation or employer is inferred.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Major Frank L. Ball Jr. is very likely the Arlington Army officer documented as a lieutenant in 1942 and a major in 1944.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Maj. Frank L. Ball, Jr., A.U.S.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Contemporary notices supply the exact full name and suffix, Arlington family, U.S. Army affiliation, and progression from lieutenant to the indexed major rank.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the exact full name and suffix, Arlington family continuity, Army affiliation, and rank progression from lieutenant in 1942 to major in 1944, matching the index.
claims.temporal_assessment: The items document wartime Army status. They do not establish an OSS recruitment date, an immediate pre-OSS assignment, or a civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: Not marked confirmed because the private officer identifier and Box 32 personnel file have not been compared. Prewar political and civic activity was not treated as employment.

claims.claim_text: The indexed First Lieutenant Leon F. Ball is the OSS officer known in France by the alias Niveau.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A sourced infiltration chronology gives the exact name with middle initial, OSS affiliation, alias Niveau, mission, and June 1944 drop; museum and municipal records corroborate the alias and lieutenant role.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the uncommon exact name with middle initial, direct OSS identification, alias Niveau, 1944 mission details, and independent French institutional corroboration of the same alias and U.S. Army lieutenant role.
claims.temporal_assessment: The evidence concerns Ball's 1944 OSS and resistance mission. It confirms identity but does not by itself establish his immediate pre-OSS affiliation.
claims.match_notes: Not marked confirmed because Box 32 and the underlying cited mission files have not been reviewed directly. The alias and exact middle initial substantially reduce namesake risk.
